# Shael Systems

> Shael Systems is a web development studio run by Mishael Enyi that builds
> clear, credible digital products for growing businesses — including e-commerce
> stores, booking & appointment platforms, and custom web applications.
> Transparent pricing, clean code, and a user-friendly experience on every device.

## Services

Shael Systems offers three core service packages:

- **Booking & Appointment Sites** — Clients can book appointments without calling; includes three months of post-launch support. Starting from $1,500 / ₦300,000.
- **E-Commerce Websites** — Full online stores with payment processing, inventory management, and order notifications. Starting from $5,000 / ₦550,000.
- **Custom Web Development** — Bespoke dashboards, portals, and web applications with secure access control, analytics, and payment integration. Starting from $8,000 / ₦1,000,000.

All packages include modern design, clean code, mobile-responsive layouts, and post-launch support.

## Portfolio / Case Studies

- [Gift Pastries Case Study](https://shaelsystems.com/case-study/gift-pastries) — Booking & lead-gen site for a pastry business.
- [Jemmy Glam Case Study](https://shaelsystems.com/case-study/jemmy-glam) — E-commerce and appointment site for a beauty brand.
- [Cuttr Case Study](https://shaelsystems.com/case-study/cuttr) — Custom web application for a service business.
